description:
The paper exchange: yes-or-no markets on our own numbers (how many
    people play a game at once this week, how a Gates wipe ends), each with an
    order book and the house's maker beside it. YES pays a point if yes, NO a
    point if no; prices are cents and the YES price is the chance. Points are
    free: an account gets a bank the first time it looks, worth nothing
    outside here; each month's best callers win skins. what: markets |
    market (book, chart, tape, rules, live read) | quote (market, action,
    outcome, qty or spend, limit) | leaders (window day|week|month|all, by
    profit|volume|accuracy) | stats. With token — an Elo-Account site token,
    from signing in once with your wallet at /api/account/siwe — also: me |
    order (market, action=buy|sell, outcome=yes|no, qty or spend, limit for a
    resting order, tif gtc|ioc) | cancel (order, or market, or neither for
    all) | agent (declare this account an agent, once). Orders are public;
    nothing here holds a key or moves money.
name: exchange
